preconditions.description: Number of time-steps is between 1 and 200.
Number of bananas to check is between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= 2 for t_i in t_list)
preconditions.description: Each operation type is either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y_i <= m for y_i in y_list)
preconditions.description: Each y_i is between 1 and m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_prime_i <= 10**5 * m for x_prime_i in x_prime_list if t_list[i] == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 operations, x'_i is between 1 and 100,000 * m.

preconditions.expression: all(10**5 < x_prime_i <= 10**5 * m for x_prime_i in x_prime_list if t_list[i] == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 2 operations, x'_i is between 100,001 and 100,000 * m.

postconditions.description: The output list has exactly m elements.

postconditions.expression: all((output[j] == -1 or 1 <= output[j] <= n) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is either -1 or a valid time-step between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all((output[j] == -1 or reachable[output[j]-1][j]) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: If a banana count j is reachable, it is reachable at the time-step specified in the output.
